input.goalText: Use AI to write clearer customer emails

proposal.subject: practical-ai
proposal.title: Write Clearer Customer Emails with AI
proposal.outcome: Draft customer emails with AI and check them against supplied facts.
proposal.reason: Start with AI’s strengths and limits, then practise prompting and revising customer emails. Learn to check drafts against supplied facts and protect sensitive information.
proposal.goalEvidence: Use AI to write clearer customer emails
proposal.context: Imagine helping a fictional shop reply to customer delivery enquiries. Use invented messages and supplied order details to practise drafting clear, polite replies without personal customer data.

modules.introduction: Explore how AI can help draft clearer customer replies and where it can introduce incorrect details or misunderstand a request.
Practise writing prompts that specify the customer’s question, supplied facts, desired tone and email length.
Practise revising AI-generated customer emails to make the wording clearer, more concise and better suited to the intended tone.
Check customer email drafts against supplied details, identify unsupported claims and practise keeping sensitive information out of prompts.

input.goalText: Use AI to summarise my study notes

proposal.subject: practical-ai
proposal.title: Use AI to Summarise and Check Study Notes
proposal.outcome: Use AI to organise study notes and verify them against supplied sources.
proposal.reason: This beginner plan focuses on AI’s strengths and limits, clear prompts for summarising study notes, and checking summaries against supplied sources while protecting private information.
proposal.goalEvidence: Use AI to summarise my study notes
proposal.context: Imagine you have fictional study notes and a supplied source passage for a class topic. You will plan an AI summary and consider how to check its accuracy without sharing private information.

modules.introduction: Explore what AI can and cannot do when summarising study notes, including why a fluent summary may still omit or misstate important points.
Focus on writing clear prompts that specify the supplied notes, desired summary length, structure and level of detail.
Focus on checking a study summary against supplied source material and deciding what private information to leave out of an AI prompt.

proposal.subject: cybersecurity
proposal.title: Recognise Phishing Messages: A Beginner Plan
proposal.outcome: Recognise suspicious messages and choose independent verification in simulations.
proposal.reason: This plan supports your goal by introducing digital risk, then building skills to recognise suspicious messages and choose independent verification in fictional simulations.
proposal.context: Imagine a fictional inbox containing simulated delivery notices and payment requests. All practice uses invented messages and details, with no real credentials or real account settings.

modules.introduction: Build a beginner understanding of digital risk through fictional message simulations, focusing on why suspicious requests can put information at risk.
Practise recognising phishing messages and choosing independent verification in fictional inbox simulations using only invented messages and details.

input.goalText: Protect my accounts with better passwords and MFA

proposal.subject: cybersecurity
proposal.title: Protecting Accounts with Better Passwords and MFA
proposal.outcome: Choose account protections and recovery steps in fictional settings.
proposal.reason: This beginner-friendly plan matches your goal by introducing account risks, then practising password, MFA and recovery choices in fictional simulations.
proposal.goalEvidence: Protect my accounts with better passwords and MFA
proposal.context: Imagine a fictional character securing mock email and shopping accounts. All activities are fictional simulations using invented credentials and mock settings, never real credentials or real account settings.

modules.introduction: Explore basic digital risks in a fictional simulation involving mock accounts, building a foundation for understanding why password and MFA choices matter.
Practise choosing better passwords, MFA options and account recovery steps in fictional simulations using invented credentials and mock account settings.

proposal.subject: practical-ai
proposal.title: Use AI to Organise and Check Study Notes
proposal.outcome: Use AI to organise study notes and verify them against supplied sources.
proposal.reason: This beginner plan focuses on your chosen priority: study notes. It covers AI strengths and limits, clear prompts for organising notes, and checking outputs against supplied sources while protecting information.
proposal.goalEvidence: Focus on AI for study notes first
proposal.context: Imagine preparing revision notes for a fictional introductory geography class. You have a short source passage and rough notes to organise with AI and check against the passage.

modules.introduction: Explore where AI can help organise the fictional geography notes and where its limits mean you should not rely on its output without checking.
Practise writing clear prompts that specify the supplied source, the study topic, and the structure you want for your revision notes.
Plan how to compare AI-generated notes with the supplied passage, identify unsupported details, and keep sensitive information out of prompts.
